symbols.name: DateOnlyConverter
symbols.summary: Provides an Entity Framework Core Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Storage.ValueConversion.ValueConverter%602 implementation to persist System.DateOnly values as System.DateTime (at midnight) for providers that do not natively support DateOnly.
symbols.remarks: The conversion stores the date component at 00:00:00 (midnight) using System.TimeOnly.MinValue to guarantee a stable and lossless round-trip between model and provider types. Typical usage in a model configuration: builder.Property(e => e.BirthDate) .HasConversion(new DateOnlyConverter()) .Metadata.SetValueComparer(new DateOnlyComparer()); Pairing the converter with BridgingIT.DevKit.Infrastructure.EntityFramework.DateOnlyComparer enables accurate change tracking for System.DateOnly properties.

symbols.name: DateOnlyConverter()
symbols.summary: Initializes a new instance of the BridgingIT.DevKit.Infrastructure.EntityFramework.DateOnlyConverter configuring the conversion logic between System.DateOnly and System.DateTime.
